gloss: attached document; supporting document; accompanying papers

definitions.gloss: attached document; supporting document; accompanying papers
definitions.explanation: Documents that are attached to an application, report, or main document as supporting evidence or required supplementary information. Commonly used in official procedures, business correspondence, tax filings, and job applications.

examples.japanese: {添付|てんぷ}{書類|しょるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦{申請書|しんせいしょ}→申請書：07486_shinseisho⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{添付|てんぷ}{書類|しょるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit the application form together with the supporting documents.

examples.japanese: {添付|てんぷ}{書類|しょるい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不備|ふび}→不備：07599_fubi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If there are deficiencies in the supporting documents, the procedure may be delayed.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビザ→ビザ：08283_biza⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧な{添付|てんぷ}{書類|しょるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大使館|たいしかん}→大使館：01457_taishikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the list of supporting documents required for the visa application on the embassy's website.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{添付|てんぷ}→添付：07376_tenpu⟧ (attachment, enclosure) + ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧ (documents, papers). A standard term in Japanese administrative and business procedures.

USAGE:
- Frequently appears on application instructions, forms, and checklists.
- The expected documents are often called ⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧{添付|てんぷ}{書類|しょるい} (required supporting documents) and may include items such as a copy of one's ID, residence certificate, income statement, or photograph.
- ⟦{添付|てんぷ}→添付：07376_tenpu⟧ also refers to email attachments, but in that context ⟦{添付|てんぷ}ファイル→添付ファイル：24475_tenpufairu⟧ (attached file) is used instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {添付|てんぷ}{書類|しょるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to submit supporting documents
- {添付|てんぷ}{書類|しょるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧: to prepare supporting documents
- ⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧{添付|てんぷ}{書類|しょるい}: required supporting documents
- {添付|てんぷ}{書類|しょるい}⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧: list of required attachments
- {添付|てんぷ}{書類|しょるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不備|ふび}→不備：07599_fubi⟧: deficiency / incompleteness of attached documents

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {別添|べってん}⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧: separately attached document — older/more formal variant
- ⟦{付属|ふぞく}→付属：27518_fuzoku⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧: accompanying document — emphasizes belonging to the main document
- ⟦{参考|さんこう}→参考：02828_sankou⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧: reference material — for information rather than official requirements
- ⟦{添付|てんぷ}ファイル→添付ファイル：24475_tenpufairu⟧: attached file (email) — the digital counterpart
